thread:
Alex (CEO): Quick weekly note — huge props to the infra and runtime teams for last week's Dedicated autoscale MVP :tada:. High-level priorities for the company this week: 1) Stabilize autoscale under mixed workloads (SRE/Eng), 2) Ship Redwood Optimize beta to early customers, 3) Close two enterprise pilot agreements, 4) Continue latency & reliability improvements across hosted API. Metrics I’m watching: weekly ARR delta +3.2%, MRR ~$1.25M, API p50=110ms p95=470ms, platform error rate ~0.9%, infra unit cost down ~4% after batching changes. Ask leads to flag any blockers by Tuesday EOD. I’ll be in customer calls Wed morning; PTO Thu morning.

Priya (VP Eng): Thanks Alex. Autoscale hotfix plan: rolling canary today -> rollback threshold at 1.5x baseline -> full rollout if stable by EOD tomorrow. Main risk: rare KV-cache eviction that surfaced in staging. Assigned oncall to deep-dive; draft PR is up: `fix/autoscale-eviction`.

Sam (VP Product): Optimize beta is green for internal QA. Customer beta cohort (5 teams) starts Monday. We'll collect perf + quality evals and iterate weekly. Will post the onboarding checklist to #devex by Friday. Need SRE help for one production test harness.

Jo (Head of Sales): Pipeline update: two pilots in final legal review — both requesting Dedicated with 12mo commit. May need a small pricing concession on one deal to close this week. Can collect docs and loop legal + finance.

Lina (CFO): Quick finance nudge: please share expected revenue timing for the two pilots (Jo) and any material discounts. Also ping product finance for the Optimize beta monetization doc — need that to forecast Q2 rev waterfall.

Maya (People Ops): Hiring pulse: we closed 3 backend offers, 2 more onsite this week for runtime team. Reminder: engineering offsite RSVP by Friday — travel stipends available.

Priya (VP Eng): Follow-up — I've scheduled a 30m incident-prep sync Thu 9am for autoscale rollout owners and oncall. Agenda: rollback plan, monitoring thresholds, comms paths.

Alex (CEO): Thanks all. Two small asks: 1) please add any cross-functional dependencies to the weekly exec doc (link in #eng), 2) tag me on customer escalations that might need exec presence. Will join the incident-prep for the first 10m.

DeployBot: canary deploy `deploy-2026-03-20-rc7` started to 6% traffic — monitoring p95 and error-rate. Alerts configured: p95 > 600ms OR errors > 2% -> auto-rollback.

Jo (Head of Sales): Noted — prepping a short summary for Legal/Finance in next 2 hours. :thumbsup:
